The mandir building project commenced with the foundation-stone laying ceremony performed by Swamishri on 15 January 2002. The mandir was completed through tremendous voluntary efforts by the devotees of Bhavnagar and thousands more had performed austerities and devotional worship and rituals for its successful completion.

Swamishri performed the murti-pratishtha rituals of Shri Akshar Purushottam Maharaj and the senior sadhus performed the rituals of the remaining murtis. After the rituals were over Swamishri also performed the first pujan of all the murtis. Thereafter annakut was displayed before the deities and Swamishri and senior sadhus performed the pratishtha arti. The pratishtha rituals concluded at 9.30 am.

At 10.30 am Swamishri was welcomed to the pratishtha assembly amidst thundering applause. Several dignitaries were honoured on stage, namely, Minister for Urban Development, Roads and Buildings Shri I.K. Jadeja, Minister for Energy Shri Saurabhbhai Patel, Mayor of Bhavnagar Shri Mehulbhai Vadodaria, MLAs Shri Sunilbhai Oza, Mahendrabhai Trivedi, leading Congress member Shri Shaktisinh Gohil and many others. After the addresses by senior sadhus and dignitaries Swamishri inaugurated three pictorial publications by Swaminarayan Aksharpith: Ramayan and Mahabharat (Hindi) and Brahmaswarup Shastriji Maharaj (English). Swamishri was then honoured with garlands by the senior sadhus. The youths of Bhavnagar performed a traditional dance celebrating the mandir inauguration. Finally, Swamishri blessed the assembly, “Our culture since time immemorial has been sustained by the Vedas and mandirs. Through mandirs one is inspired with character and values. Through one’s association with mandirs and a bonafide Sadhu one’s senses revert within. Bhagwan Swaminarayan came on earth to inspire character, values and to grant moksha to people. He has given a beautiful code of ethics in the Shikshapatri. It prescribes injunctions for the happiness of mankind. He has given two great things in it ‘Dharmo gneyah sadE3chE3rah’ (righteous living). If one lives righteously then there will be no hatred for others. You follow the faith you believe in by obeying the moral codes written in your scriptures, but do not villify other faiths. And the second thing is to live an addiction-free life.”
More than 31,000 devotees attended the pratishtha festival and partook of the mahaprasad.

Yesterday, during Swamishri’s evening dinner, devotees from the towns of Eganga, Kaliro, Bigori, Mabale, Jinja, Tororo and others gave reports of their satsang activities. A yagna for the murti-pratishtha rituals was performed yesterday morning in the mandir hall.

In the morning Ishwarcharan Swami, Viveksagar Swami, Anandswarup Swami and Bhaktavatsal Swami performed the first part of the murti-pratishtha rituals of the murtis of Akshar-Purushottam Maharaj, Radha-Krishna Dev and Guru Parampara. Thereafter the senior sadhus addressed the assembly. In the evening, before presiding over the Satsang assembly, Swamishri performed the final pratishtha rituals of arti and pujan of the murtis. Thereafter Swamishri attended the joint pratishtha, centenary celebration and farewell assembly. Youths performed a drama on how the 200-year-feud between the villagers of Odarka and Kukad was resolved by Swamishri. Thereafter a traditional dance was performed. Then Swamishri was honoured with garlands by senior sadhus and devotees. Finally Swamishri blessed the assembly, “In the Bhagvad Gita Shri Krishna says that God comes on earth to destroy unrighteousness and evil, and establish dharma and protect and liberate mankind. Bhagwan Ram destroyed Ravan. Bhagwan Shri Krishna taught the Gita. Bhagwan Swaminarayan came on earth with his abode (dham) and muktas to liberate countless souls. He taught all to abstain from addictions, violence, stealing, meat-eating and adultery. He taught that one should respect and perform acts that bring happiness to all. Bhagwan Swaminarayan did not fight battles and did not kill evil men, but transformed their evil nature and blessed them with dharma, gnan, vairagya and bhakti to make them happy. Then Gunatitanand Swami continued his mission. Thereafter Bhagatji Maharaj came and Shastriji Maharaj established the BAPS. Yogiji Maharaj had also been here, and he too blessed all with happiness. So, the mission of Bhagwan Swaminarayan was for the good and benefit of all mankind. For this purpose the pratishtha of God’s murtis has been completed today. May all imbibe the knowledge of God in their lives.” During Swamishri’s dinner devotees from the villages of Mabale, Kyunga, Lira, Barara, Aruva, Saroti and others were present for darshan.

Every night when Swamishri retires to bed sadhus come for his darshan. Tonight, Swamishri was a little early. The sadhus were singing the ritual chesta in the assembly hall, a little distance away. On seeing only a few sadhus outside Swamishri enquired whether everyone was late. The attendant sadhus replied that everyone was singing the chesta and that they would come shortly. So Swamishri sat patiently waiting on his bed. Shortly, when all the sadhus arrived Swamishri folded his palms and bid ‘Jai Swaminarayan’ to all. Swamishri waited to fulfil everyone’s wish for darshan and furthermore, he, too, wished to have darshan of the sadhus. Such is the glory he has for all.

To please Bhagwan Swaminarayan and guru Pramukh Swami Maharaj children, youths and senior devotees perform austerities, pilgrimages and other devotional means. The spiritual endeavours performed by devotees during Swamishri’s visit to the local centres are congratulatory and worthy of recognition. They also reflect Swamishri’s divinity for inspiring such spiritual efforts in children, teenagers and devotees.

After completing the pran pratishtha rites in the three spired mandir in Bhadra, Pramukh Swami Maharaj came to the podium outside the mandir. As per the wish of the late Ghanshyamsinh Bapu and Mansukhbhai, flower petals were to be showered by helicopter. A helicopter was to come specially from Mumbai.

Swamishri sat waiting on the podium. However, as the sun was harsh, Swamishri was taken to the rear part of the mandir's circumambulation path. When news came after a while, Swamishri came back to the mandir podium. Within a short while the helicopter passed near the spire of the mandir. Because of the pressure created by the helicopter's blades, dust was flying fiercely. To keep that dust from going into Swamishri's eyes, his eyes were first covered with a hand, and then immediately his spectacles were put on.
Seeing the wish of a devoted devotee who had passed away years ago being fulfilled, Swamishri was very satisfied. It was as if Swamishri was praising in this way the years old seva of that devotee.

After completing the pran pratishtha rites, Pramukh Swami Maharaj came to his residence and sat down to have his meal. Before that, Dr Kiranbhai Doshi measured Swamishri's blood pressure. Even after so much exertion, the blood pressure was 108 and the pulse was 60. The doctor was surprised to see this. So Swamishri said, "It is Gunatit's place, and the festival has been grand, so God will certainly keep the health good, won't he!"

After completing the installation rites, Pramukh Swami Maharaj was to have his meal and then come to the installation assembly. Even during the meal, Swamishri kept thinking only of the devotees. In the middle of the meal, Swamishri specially called Dharmakunvar Swami and Narayanmuni Swami and, expressing his wish, said, "If there are valuable shawls in the mandir, bring five or ten. We want to honour Chandrakantbhai, Kumarbhai and Dhruv of the Pujara family, who sponsored the mandir, and Nirmalsinh, Pravinsinh, Rajendrasinh and Shambhusinh of the family of Dajibapu, Ghanshyamsinh Bapu." Throughout the meal, this same talk and arrangement continued. However, enough shawls were not available in the mandir, so Swamishri said, "Can shawls come from Jamnagar or Rajkot before the assembly is over?"
However, that was not possible, so Swamishri left that ceremony for tomorrow and gave instructions for shawls to be sent for in the meantime.

For the successful completion of the Bhadra murti installation festival, a total of 2,225 male and female volunteers were at work in 23 departments. But in 1969, when Yogiji Maharaj installed the mandir right here, there was no such corps of volunteers. If you count a corps, it was Swamishri's faith in Shriji Maharaj, and if you count strength, it was Swamishri's unbroken devotion to Shriji Maharaj and his devotion to his guru, Yogiji Maharaj. A priceless record of Swamishri's hard work at that time is found on page after page of the diaries he himself wrote. This is a golden documentary page of history.
A few of those original pages are presented here as a memento. The same details have been typed and placed here.
The serious problem of water:

At that time, where to bring water from was itself a big problem, but keeping faith in Yogiji Maharaj's blessings, Swamishri truly fought it out. Not one of the Patels' wells in the village had enough water to last until the festival was over. On the opposite bank of the river was the well of Nathabhai Pedhadiya. It was decided to arrange the water from there.
Swamishri has noted:
8 March 1969: Discussion about making a well on the opposite bank of the river and doing the motor works with a pipe from there.
Swamishri has noted the details of starting to dig the well on 10 March 1969. Swamishri wrote:
"Today, after nine in the morning, the auspicious start was made for digging the well on the opposite bank of the river."
On 13 March 1969 Swamishri noted:

"Today the contract for digging about 4,500 feet of pipeline from the river to the dharmashala was given to a Harijan from Kharva at the rate of 95 paise per foot. Pujya Ishwarcharan Swami and Devcharan went to Davol to get the pipes."
In the same way, on 15 March 1969 Swamishri noted:
"Digging of the pipeline began today."
On 17 March 1969 Swamishri noted in his diary:

"Shikshapatri recitation begun. Today the masonry work of the well was started in the afternoon. There were no labourers, so it was started with our own hands. Fifteen courses were completed by evening..."

ds.t: I do not feel like leaving
w: Having finished puja in his room, Mahant Swami Maharaj came to the balcony. Based on the book "Purushottam Bolya Prite," he showered blessings: "'The darshan of this assembly...' (emphasising these words, he said them again:) 'If anyone remembers the darshan of this assembly at the end of life, his prarabdha (destiny from past karma) is destroyed. Once his prarabdha is destroyed, he attains liberation.' Such knowledge is found nowhere in the universe. 'The avatars meditate on this assembly. We and the muktas also meditate on it.' Shriji Maharaj meditates on it! And we become harsh and press others down... But if we become simple, Bhagwan gives us great happiness. We feel that Bhagwan has spoiled things, but Bhagwan makes us happy. Just as a doctor operates, cuts and removes a lump, so he removes the lump. 'The sadhus and devotees look like humans, but they are not humans...' Then what are they? Divine. Only when there is a heap of merit can one enter this satsang. '...What we have said, we say holding back our tongue; we do not tell it as we see it...' That is, we enjoy it within our own minds."

The blessings were over. When the attendant requested him to stand up, he stood up, but he called Atmaswarupdas Swami and said, "I do not feel like leaving." He conveyed what was in Swamishri's mind over the microphone... Everyone's heart was filled with emotion, but he did have to go, so he lovingly folded his hands to everyone and went to his room.
After finishing breakfast, Mahant Swami Maharaj was taking the medicine prescribed by the doctors when Gunvatsaldas Swami said, "Give us these medicines to swallow..."
Swamishri said, "Shriji Maharaj asked for the devotees' suffering; where is there any question of giving it away?"
Everyone fell still. His oneness with Shriji Maharaj was revealed on this occasion.
After walking on the treadmill, Mahant Swami Maharaj sat in a chair to rest, and a conversation began.
Dr V. P. Patel asked, "If Aksharbrahman takes one step, how many universes are passed?"
Swamishri said, "Countless."
The doctor said, "This talk of Akshar is so great that when we think of it, we are left saying 'Wow! Wow!' and if we understand it, we keep bathing in an ocean of unbroken bliss... but
that can only be recognised if you show compassion, can't it?! Because you are attained through grace, not through effort."

Swamishri said yes. Then he added, "Often, even when people are together with him, they do not recognise him. Many sadhus lived with Swami (Gunatitanand Swami) but did not recognise him, and Bhagatji Maharaj recognised him. He refused to walk behind him, saying, 'The light of millions of suns comes out of Swami's quilt.'"
The doctor said, "For those who live close by and do not recognise him, it is a great loss, because they had the chance to recognise him."
Swamishri said, "Swami has said, hasn't he: the Yadavs were forever unfortunate..."
It was as if Swamishri was saying meaningfully: you too have received a great attainment, but take care that it does not become like the Yadavs.
Tonight, when Mahant Swami Maharaj sat on his bed to go to sleep, Tyagswarupdas Swami asked, "While eating, you close your eyes for a while. Are you meditating?"
"No, I am remembering Yogi Bapa," said Swamishri.
Though seated as the guru, Swamishri never forgets Hari in the form of his guru.
"Even if he were given the wealth of the three worlds, he would not give up
even half a moment of meditating on Hari; becoming brahmarup, he worships Hari..."
